title: axx fixture
description: A *.fixture.yaml: one fixture. The file name is the fixture key and its outputs are generated next to it. An empty or comment-only file is a fixture that is exactly the prototype. Reference it with: # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://axx.nimbusxr.us/schemas/v0/axx-fixture.schema.json

factory.description: The factory this fixture belongs to. Omit it when exactly one factory sits in this directory or the nearest ancestor that has one. A bare name (event) finds the nearest ancestor event.factory.yaml; a path (checkout/events/event) is relative to fixtures.baseDir and binds from anywhere.

data.description: The fixture's values, deep-merged over the prototype (maps merge, lists and scalars replace). A value at an identity path pins that identity. Scalars may be ${ fn(args) } expressions; {$ref: path#/pointer} takes a value from another fixture.

metadata.description: What travels beside the values (a message key, headers), layered over the factory's metadata.
